items.title: Uber Reveals AI Agents Barely Make a Dent: Just 504 Orders and Rides Against 320 Million Weekly Transactions — ‘Very, Very Early and Very Limited Traction’
items.summary: Uber Technologies Inc. revealed that artificial intelligence agents generated just 504 orders and rides during Halloween week, compared with approximately 320 million trips across its platforms, highlighting how little autonomous AI has penetrated everyday consumer services. items.title: Uber CEO Won’t Depend on “the Googles of the World” Again. AI Agents Booked 4 Trips
items.summary: Key TakeawaysUber’s management said on its third-quarter call that AI agents sent it around 500 Uber Eats orders and 4 rides, against about 320 million trips in Halloween week. CEO Dara Khosrowshahi said he doesn’t want Uber dependent on an outside gatekeeper again, and MercadoLibre and JPMorgan are keeping outside agents away from their inventory and accounts too.
